Expect a high around 24°C, a 60% chance of showers, and a risk of thunderstorms through the morning and afternoon, with 10 to 20 mm of rain possible. It gets gusty from the southwest, up to 40 km/h near noon. Tuesday night drops to about 12°C with more showers likely. This is from this morning's forecast.
